descriptions.zh:
一股可感的寂静降临在[root.GetName]各处。远近各处的朝圣者踏上旅途，前往选定好的礼拜场所；一路上结识新友，重温故交。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者们据传对此悲喜交加。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番温暖人心的布道，号召信徒们好好培养、呵护他们之间的关系，在互惠互利中繁荣兴旺。

随着[mortal_initiate.GetName]向祭献堂进发，群众们以叹息为他们送别。他们于此刻迎接终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
descriptions.en:
A palpable hush descends across the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims have journeyed from near and far to their chosen places of worship, forming new friendships and rekindling old ones along their way.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-emerged [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession is said to have drawn smiles and tears alike. The principal Death Priest at [capital_scope.GetName] led a warm sermon, calling for the faithful to be nurturing and considerate of their relationships, and to thrive in our mutuality.

As each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber, collective sighs rang out. Each has met their end now, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

descriptions.zh:
兴奋的低语在[root.GetName]上传开。朝圣者们在选定好的礼拜场所等待，纵然旅途劳顿，依旧激动非常。

新近浮现的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]们也遵行并参与了我们社会中的仪式，他们列队前进，不发一言，旁观者向他们礼貌地致以谢意。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长领头作了一番兴高采烈的布道，号召信徒们把握好分分秒秒中的欢愉。随着仪式最高潮的时刻到来，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们在狂热的掌声中向着祭献堂进发。他们于此刻迎接终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
descriptions.en:
Excited murmurings ripple over the [root.GetName]. Pilgrims await at their chosen places of worship, buoyed by an excitement quite at odds with any physical weariness they may have endured.

Our society's rituals have been observed and invested in the newly-emerged [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession was met with polite expressions of gratitude. The principal Death Priest at [capital_scope.GetName] led a vigorous sermon, calling for the faithful to seize the joy in every moment. As the climactic moment came, each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber under rapturous applause. Each has met their end now, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

titles.en: A Sacrifice Made: Bounty for the [root.GetName]

descriptions.zh:
富足感洋溢在[root.GetName]各处，朝圣者在选定好的礼拜场所聚集。他们间或献上祭品；许多人藉此从为圣地服务的无数小摊小贩和街边店铺中获利。

这一轮的[mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]遵行并参与了各式各样的仪式，他们的队列饰以多姿多彩的花环，不发一言地前行。[capital_scope.GetName]的死亡司祭长做了一番意味深长的布道，许诺所有人都会有多产而舒适的时代。

布道结束后，[mortal_initiate.GetName]们向着祭献堂进发，在那里迎接自己的终结，为仁学研究留下了光辉的一笔。
descriptions.en:
A sense of wellbeing can already be felt throughout the [root.GetName] as pilgrims gather at their chosen places of worship. Sometimes they make offerings; many take advantage of the myriad stalls and street sellers which serve our holy sites.

Various rituals have been observed and invested in this cycle's [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural], whose silent procession was festooned with garlands of various kinds. The principal Death Priest at [capital_scope.GetName] led an inspiring sermon, promising productive and comfortable times for all.

At the sermon's close, each [mortal_initiate.GetName] proceeded to the sacrificial chamber to meet their end, leaving a legacy in benevolent study.

descriptions.zh:
我们的首席执行官们刚刚聚集在一起，召开全息会议讨论丧尸卫生产品销售的增长，这时，复活资产公司某个辅助机构的负责人突然闯进了会议大厅。“§Y[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]§!上的一个丧尸已经成功地偿还了债务！”其他人还没搞懂什么情况，负责人就脱口而出。会议暂时停顿，随后陷入一片混乱。每个与会的执行官都要求知道，这可能会如何影响对他们的复活工人的供应。

经过更多的分析，结果是这只是一个极其罕见的案例。只有那些身体维持了整整一个世纪的死者能够偿还他们的债务——就大局而言，这个数字微不足道。如果让它们安息，我们的星海企业几乎注意不到这件事。
descriptions.en:
Our chief executives had all just gathered for a holo-meeting to discuss the growth of zombie hygiene product sales when one of the heads of Animated Assets' aids burst into the conference hall. "One of the Zombies on §Y[debt_free_zombie.Planet.GetName]§! has managed to work off their debt!" they blurt out before noticing what they had stumbled in on. A pause stretched in the meeting before pandemonium erupted. Every assembled executive demanded to know how this might impact their reanimated workers supply.

After some more analysis, it turned out that this was only an extraordinarily rare case. Only the deceased whose bodies had lasted a whole century had managed to pay off their debts - a minuscule number, on the grand scale. Our galactic corporation would barely notice if they were to be put to rest.

label.zh: 它们已经赢得了自己的自由，让它们休息吧。
label.en: They have earned their freedom, let them rest.

label.zh: 往债务上多加几个0就完事儿了。
label.en: Just add some more 0s to their debt.

descriptions.zh:
索林原虫尝试进入§R我们§!！

这个系外入侵者迅速捕获我们的[root.GetNecromancersLower]。从中其他的虫群开始收集更多附近的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]。我们需要清除整个感染仓以确保[Root.GetName]的安全。
descriptions.en:
The Prethoryn tried to enter §Rus§!!

The extragalactic invader immediately seized our [root.GetNecromancersLower]. From there, the alien entity began collecting additional [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] from nearby. We had to eliminate the entire infiltration pod to keep the [Root.GetName] secure.
